title: Unmetabolized folic acid is detected in nearly all serum samples from US children, adolescents, and adults
authors: Pfeiffer CM, Sternberg MR, Fazili Z, Yetley EA, Lacher DA, Bailey RL, et al.
population: US population aged 1 year and over in NHANES 2007-2008, under mandatory fortification
funder: The authors reported no funding received for this study. All authors were employed by the CDC or the NIH Office of Dietary Supplements.
result: Unmetabolised folic acid was detectable (above 0.3 nmol/L) in more than 95% of both users and non-users of folic acid-containing supplements, regardless of demographic group or fasting. Geometric mean UMFA 1.54 nmol/L in users and 0.794 nmol/L in non-users; 5-methyl-THF 48.4 and 30.7 nmol/L. UMFA above 1 nmol/L in 33.2% overall and 21.0% of fasting adults, associated with older age, non-Hispanic black ethnicity, non-fasting, smaller body surface area, higher total folic acid intake and higher red cell folate.
